text: Customer placed order QF-20417 for a Quillridge 3-person tent and asked about delivery time. Told standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days.
Customer reported the Fernglow lantern from QF-20388 arrived with a cracked lens. Photos were attached and a refund was requested.
Customer asked whether the Emberhollow lid from QF-20402 could be exchanged for a larger one. Told cookware sets are returned as a whole.
Customer placed QF-20430 for the 45L pack and then asked about swapping sizes before shipping.
Customer asked what temperature rating the Mothdown bag in QF-20433 is. Told 0C comfort limit.
Customer asked about the warranty on the Quillridge 2-person tent in QF-20371 after a pole bent. Told tents have a 2 year warranty.
Order QF-20355 was cancelled while processing and refunded to the original payment method.
Customer asked whether a price drop on a Fernpath pack after purchase could be adjusted. Told price adjustments are honoured within 7 days.
Customer asked if free shipping applied to an order of 60 dollars. Told the threshold is over 75 dollars.
Customer asked where shipment QT-58120394 was. Last scan was the Harbour District sort hub.
